svg.text: L_SM — the Standard-Model Higgs hat and the path of the action
V(h) = −μ²h²/2 + λh⁴/4 (brim radius 1, depth 1). Coloured lines: every stationary path (δS = 0) between the same two events, found by solving the Euler–Lagrange equations; nothing is aimed.
the brim: the vacuum circle (V minimum, the Goldstone directions run around it)
inflection circle r = 1/√3: curvature changes sign (inside: tachyonic, outside: stable)
stationary path, Morse index 0 (a minimum of the action), S = 0.7742
stationary path, index 1 (a saddle: a neighbouring path does less work), S = 0.7906
stationary path, index 2, S = 10.88: swings out to r = 2.66 and back; drawn only inside r = 1.6
grey-blue: the whole fan of paths from the brim point at E = 0 (every launch direction)
